verdict.rationale: mParticle has a documented Profile API: Profile API docs pages exist, there is a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization' doc, and IDSync builds a unified customer view. The evidence is mostly page titles, though, and does not show what a profile query returns or how it is queried. missing for 10: evidence that the profile API returns traits, identifiers and event history; query/endpoint documentation details; a machine-readable spec for the Profile API; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can query unified customer profiles — traits, identifiers, event history — through a documented profile API or store

citations.quote: Real-time API to drive user personalization
IDSync is mParticle's identity resolution framework, enabling you to create a unified view of your customers
Get a complete view of your users
the Platform and Profile API pages carry no spec
